theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]

    grind only [ChoiceBisim, → Bisimilarity.symm]

    refine ⟨t', ?_, .bisim h'⟩
    try apply Tr.choiceL
    exact ht'

229: 
230: /-- Bisimulations equipped with union form a join-semilattice. -/
231: instance : SemilatticeSup {r // IsBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ r} where
232:   sup r s := r ⊔ s
233:   le_sup_left r s := by simp [←Subtype.coe_le_coe]
234:   le_sup_right r s := by simp [←Subtype.coe_le_coe]
235:   sup_le r s t := by simp [←Subtype.coe_le_coe]; tauto

239: theorem IsBisimulation.bot : IsBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ Relation.emptyHRelation := by
240:   intro s₁ s₂ hr

252: - Bisimilarity is the top element.
